businessGoal: Allow visitors to find specific products within a category through browsing.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the category page is displayed with the correct products and page title after clicking a category name.
Verify that all filters (category checkboxes, brand checkboxes, sorting dropdown, pagination controls) are available on the category page.

manual.reason: The story details visible behaviors that can be manually tested.

api.reason: The story does not explicitly mention API capabilities or behavior, and no API endpoints are indicated.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria describe visible browser behavior regarding the category page and filters.
